items.evidence: I decoded all 32 kit hits, the verify-1 versions (git 4137138fe, 96 files) and the current ones (122 files), and ran my own FFT. Cues that meet both floors (2-6 kHz >= 4 %, >6 kHz >= 0.6 %): 12 -> 23 (the claim says 24). Median energy above 6 kHz: 0.16 % -> 1.46 %. Median centroid: 1006 -> 1215 Hz. f_lisvel_hit 3.1 % / 0.04 % -> 4.3 % / 2.6 %. f_sukri_attack_hit 0.7 / 0.0 -> 5.6 / 3.8. f_vashil_attack_hit 0.2 / 0.03 -> 6.2 / 1.4. f_tunlan_attack_hit 4.8 / 0.04 -> 14.6 / 1.3. On average, 74 % of the HF energy lands in the first 27 ms, so the added air reads as part of the contact, not as a late hiss. In the sfx2 sheet, the grit on lisvel and vashil is bursty but irregular, a crumble and not a zipper. Residual: the onsets are no snappier. Median onset-to-peak is 6.5 -> 6.4 ms, against the plan's target of 3 ms or less. f_lisvel_hit is still 23 ms, f_ulkro_hit 50 ms, f_hesmi_attack_hit 32 ms, f_nurrow_hit 18 ms. Still dark: dunsom both slots (0.0 / 0.1 % >6k), tunlan_hit 0.00, ulkro_attack_hit 0.02, hesmi_attack_hit 0.01, lisvel_attack_hit 0.15, nurrow_hit 2.4 % 2-6k. The engineer listed these honestly.

26 of 32 kit hits now ship 4 takes, and each .ogg has a current .m4a sibling. Content file lists resolve: 0 missing. My own STFT log-magnitude correlation between takes (first 0.5 s): median 0.971 -> 0.942. Big drops: rishal_attack_hit 0.968 -> 0.866, ervet_hit 0.942 -> 0.862, burdam_hit 0.973 -> 0.902, sukri_hit 0.965 -> 0.903. A few got more alike: lisvel_attack_hit 0.960 -> 0.986, marund_attack_hit 0.915 -> 0.957, kemdo_attack_hit stays 0.991, ilsheta_attack_hit stays 0.986. On a time-insensitive average-spectrum correlation the median moved only 0.965 -> 0.968, so the variation is mostly in time and envelope, not in timbre.

build.py --gates (my run) prints w_wick_hit tf 0.949, w_glimwick_hit 0.945, w_wick_hit_heavy 0.954, w_brightwick_swing 0.769, w_greatwick_throw 0.816, and the new WICK_TAKE_TF_MAX 0.965 gate is in build.py. Verify-1's residual (0.987-0.994) is closed.
Re-ran on the current build: A -5.01, B all -999, C -7.09, D -7.6, E -999, F -5.08, PASS. Was FAIL at E (-11.71 dBFS).

Diff: 'proc.item' with no own cue now has a 1.5 s gap per item and owner, at -4 dB. In my captures c_proc_item played 26 times in 300 s (Vashil seed 11), 3.0 % of heard energy on Lisvel seed 21. That is out of the top 6 (it was 12.5 % before). Presentation only, typecheck OK.

problems.what: probe_audio_runtime fails on the current build: master integrated loudness is below the owner's tokens, and the fighter kit share is under 50 % on a jungle-heavy seed
problems.evidence: My scratchpad captures. Vashil seed 11: I -19.95 LUFS (floor -19.5). Lisvel seed 21: I -20.18 LUFS and fighterKitShareGe50 47.5 %, pass false. The engineer's seed 21 also failed (-19.6, 46.4 %). Only Lisvel seed 3 passes.
problems.fix: Raise the sfx bus or the gain of the bound library jungle and cast cues (c_cast_big, c_monster_fall, c_hit_magic, c_needle_shot), or give jungle monsters and kitted casts their own f_* or m_* binding. Then show integrated loudness of -19.5 or more and kit share of 50 % or more on seeds 3, 11 and 21 (300 s each) on one build.

problems.what: SFX-2 delivered air but not snap: onset-to-peak is unchanged, and 9 kit hits stay under the floors
problems.evidence: Median rise 6.5 -> 6.4 ms (plan: 3 ms or less). f_lisvel_hit 23 ms, f_ulkro_hit 50 ms, f_hesmi_attack_hit 32 ms. Dunsom (both slots), tunlan_hit, ulkro_attack_hit and hesmi_attack_hit have about 0 % above 6 kHz.
problems.fix: Move the crack peak to the sample-accurate onset (lead the body by 2-4 ms), and re-voice the dunsom/rishal/odrum neighbour pair so the dark cues can take a crack and still keep the 8 dB identity bar.

problems.what: The lane relaxed its own QA window (IMPW minimum 0.15 -> 0.14 s) to pass a shaped f_odrum_hit take
problems.evidence: audio/cues/kits_c.py diff since 4137138fe. It is not an owner bar, and the engineer reported it.
problems.fix: None needed if the lead accepts it; otherwise lengthen that take's body decay.

The perf run did not measure timing (load 3.4-4.2), and none is claimed. typecheck OK; content:check 0 warnings; audio/build.py --gates PASS (kit, wick, control, proc, as-heard, impact, instant, epic); probe_audio_qpop PASS; probe_audio_runtime FAIL on 2 of 2 fresh captures (see problems). The lane makes no GPU change.
notes: The lane is clearly better than before the lane (SFX-1 and SFX-5 to SFX-9 were verified in verify-1; in this round SFX-2 and the SFX-3 build half moved measurably, and I re-measured them on the decoded files). No sensitivity or originality issue: these are synthesized procedural cues, with no library or LoL samples. The verdict fails on the live-mix probe gate: on the current build the master's integrated loudness misses the owner's tokens on 3 of 5 captures. Score 7.0 against the gauge: the material identity and variation are good, but the hits still lack a sharp onset, and the live mix is quiet and leans on library cues in jungle-heavy games.
